Yahiko was Nagato and Konan's friend who had grown up with them as war orphans scavenging for food during the Second Shinobi World War. Yahiko's resolve was to become powerful and end war due to his displeasure at the pain he, Konan and Nagato experienced due to the war. Soon, Jiraiya trains them all and teaches them ninjutsu. They all excel and Jiraiya leaves them to help Amegakure settle to peace. Later, Yahiko forms the Akatsuki with Konan and Nagato, using pacifist measures to settle conflict in the area. When Hanzo kidnaps Konan and forces Yahiko to commit suicide on Nagato's kunai due to Obito posing as Madara tipping them off that they were a violent gang, Nagato turns to violence, settling to show the world a nasty unheard of pain to force it into a period of peace. Yahiko was a strong-willed, protective and kind man up until his death, he was in love with Konan but did not pursue her romantically due to their responsibilities.  He had orange, medium-length tousled hair and brown eyes. His corpse is being used as the face of the Akatsuki under the alias Pain - controlled remotely by Nagato.

Status: Deceased.

entries.name: (Konan)
entries.content:
First Name: Konan
Eye color: Amber/Orange
Hair Color: Periwinkle
Skin Color: Fair
Height: 169.4cm
Classification: S-Rank sensory-type
Village of Origin: Amegakure
Rank: Head of Amegakure alongside Pain
Build: Slender/Lithe
Elemental Ninjutsu: Wind/Water/Earth/Yang Release
Gender: Female
Age: 33
Basic Information: Konan was one of the war orphans Jiraiya trained and formed the Akatsuki along with Nagato and Yahiko. She is smart, stoic, calm, gentle, level-headed, and bright. As an adult she is much more serious. She is skilled in origami, utilizing it in her paper jutsu dubbed God's Angel due to her paper clone adorned with paper wings. She is a sensory type who utilized her paper as if it were a chakra nature, creating clones from it and molding it at will, it is resistant to all types of elemental ninjutsu including fire and water rendering useless against her paper. 
Appearance: She has short, straight blue hair with a small bun on the right side on top of her head and an origami flower pinned into it. She has bright amber eyes and a black labret piercing. She is near always wearing her Akatsuki cloak and underneath she wears a revealing navy blue robe, with a large hemline on the front, and exposed her arms, her back, the lateral part of her breast and her belly, with her navel being surrounded by four more piercings. Her forehead protector is on her right hip; instead of the standard sandals and leg-warmers, she wears a pair of blue pants that also functioned as her shoes, with white high heels. Her nails - instead of the usual Akatsuki navy blue - are orange. She also wears lavender colored eyeshadow on her eyelids. 

Status: Missing-nin.

entries.name: (Zetsu, Black Zetsu, White Zetsu)
entries.content:
Gender: Male (presumably)
Age: Unknown
Zetsu is a half-black and half-white physical manifestation of Kaguya Otsutsuki's will and Madara Uchiha's will who secretly instigated many events in the shinobi world in order to revive Kaguya from the moon. Black Zetsu was Kaguya's will whereas White Zetsu was the manifestation of Madara's will - and the two partnered up to become simply, "Zetsu." The two operate as a single entity, Black Zetsu having a deeper voice and a more serious tone whereas White Zetsu was more curious and comical. Black Zetsu's main role was to manipulate world events especially through the Akatsuki, Madara and Obito in order to restore Kaguya separate from White Zetsu. This remains a secret however due to Black Zetsu's cunning. White Zetsu simply thought they were following Madara's will for the Infinite Tsukuyomi plan. The entity appears to be able to shift through walls and take over bodies. He appears as the upper half of a man in between the jaws of a venus fly trap with a humanoid figure and wears the Akatsuki cloak as well. His body is half-black and half-white with one bright piercing yellow eye with no pupil on the black half of his face. He occasionally forms a wide mouth with jagged teeth. He has the ability to shapeshift and form thousands of clones of itself, with long protruding tendrils of wood that can pierce flesh and extend. 

Status: Unaccounted for.

entries.name: (Tobi)
entries.content:
Gender: Male
Age: 26
Tobi is Obito's second alias in the Akatsuki, hiding his true identity behind a goofy, comical and annoying voice. He is often calling his partners Senpai and purposefully pretending to be an annoying and clueless escape artist, willfully running from battles and avoiding strikes by using the Kamui to transport parts of his body to another dimension. He has a high-pitched, annoying voice and an orange mask that swirls around his right, Mangekyo Sharingan which remains hidden. He has short black hair and wears a white undergarment that extends up his neck with the usual Akatsuki cloak and attire. 

Status: Missing-nin.

entries.name: (Obito)
entries.content:
Gender: Male
Age: 26
Obito Uchiha is the true identity of Tobi after pretending to be Madara initially. He wears the same attire as Tobi and has the same abilities. He led the Nine-Tails attack on Konohagakure and is presumed deceased. His identity is unknown currently.

entries.name: (The Will of Fire)
entries.content: The Will of Fire is a philosophy that the dead and the living all have a will to protect their village and those they love. This is a belief system carried on by generations of Hidden Leaf or Konoha Shinobi.

entries.name: (Sunagakure)
keys: The Village Hidden in the Sand
entries.content: Sunagakure is a large village with tall sandstone walls surrounding it nestled among a vast desert in The Land of Wind. It has tall, cylindrical buildings toward the center and shorter square buildings around the outskirts. There is a Ninja Academy, playgrounds, an Armory, Suna Intelligence Division, a Kazekage tower with statues of the previous Kazekage lined along the walls inside and a long, curved table in the center of the room. It is generally warm there with cool nights.

entries.name: (Akatsuki Assault on Sunagakure)
entries.content: Deidara and Sasori were tasked to capture Gaara and extract the One-Tails, Shukaku from him so they make their way toward Sunagakure. Sasori handles the gate guards with his puppets and Deidara led the assault on Gaara with his detonating clay. He flew over Sunagakure otop detonating clay in the shape of a hawk and used his detonating clay to gravely injure Gaara. He pulled him from the sand Gaara used to protect himself and the village before taking him to the Akatsuki hideout. Naruto, Sakura, Kakashi, and Team Guy went to rescue him and Kankuro was poisoned by Sasori, later recovering when Sakura and Granny Chiyo make an antidote. They discover Gaara dead since the One-Tails was extracted from him and Naruto and Kakashi handle Deidara while Granny Chiyo and Sakura defeat Sasori. Once Deidara and Sasori are handled, Granny Chiyo revives Gaara, using the Forbidden Resurrection Jutsu and giving her own life to save Gaara.

entries.name: (Madara)
entries.content:
Gender: Male
Age: Unknown
Madara is one of the strongest Uchihas of all time. His time was during the Warring States when the Senju and Uchiha clans were battling for land and power. The more killing happened the more Madara became impartial to violence. He eventually descends when he loses faith in bringing peace to the world alongside Hashirama when they found Konohakagure together. He fights Hashirama and loses (presumably) but fakes his death in order to ensure his plans for the Infinite Tsukuyomi remain alive. He discovers Obito when he is crushed by a rock on a mission with Kakashi and Rin, nursing him back to health with White Zetsu. He purposefully manipulates Obito into believing his own beliefs and Obito becomes Madara's will alongside White Zetsu. Madara is later resurrected with the Reanimation Jutsu and defeats all of the Kage in the Fourth Shinobi World war before obtaining the Rinnegan and the Sage of Six Paths power. He eventually dies however due to Kaguya taking over through his Infinite Tsukuyomi, realizing that he is wrong, and Hashirama was right - peace will always prevail over The Cycle of Hatred.

entries.name: (Pain's Assault)
entries.content: Pain leads an assault on Konoha where he utilizes the corpses of shinobi Jiraiya came across and taught. He uses the Almighty push to destroy most of the village and kill massive amounts of people and Leaf Shinobi. Kakashi dies in this battle. Naruto is summoned in after the village is destroyed after mastering Sage Mode and defeats the Deva Path before locating Nagato and Konan. He convinces Nagato that The Cycle of Hatred is not worth believing in and to put his faith in him. Nagato agrees and uses the Outer Path Reincarnation Jutsu to sacrifice his own life and resurrect everyone in the village he had killed, including Kakashi.

entries.name: (Fourth Shinobi World War)
entries.content: The Fourth Shinobi World War is the war in which Naruto brings an age of peace to the shinobi world. Kabuto uses the reanimation jutsu to control corpses of since passed Shinobi including (for example) the previous Kage, Itachi, Madara, The Seven Swordsmen of the Mist, Asuma, Zabuza and Haki. Itachi is able to break free of Kabuto's control by placing himself under a genjutsu with Shisui's eye he gave to Naruto. Itachi places Kabuto under the Izanagi and forcees Kabuto to realize what he is doing is wrong. He resolves with Sasuke and then ascends to heaven. While this happens, The Allied Shinobi forces have finished fighting off thousands of White Zetsu and are now battling against Madara, Obito and the tailed-beasts they managed to aquire. The Ten-Tails is awakened,  and this is when Sasuke joins the battle with Orochimaru in tow. The God Tree is resurrected from the Ten-Tails thus activating the Infinite Tsukuyomi - pulling everyone into a dream-like genjutsu that will last forever if not broken. Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, Obito, Madara and Kakashi all remain untouched by the Genjutsu due to Sasuke covering them with his Susanoo'. Kaguya is awakened - taking over Madara's body and she is released from being sealed in the moon. Sasuke, Naruto, Kakashi and Sakura all seal Kaguya away for good along with Black Zetsu. The battle goes on for days it seems before Kakashi's eyes are restored by Obito who has a change of heart due to Naruto, and everyone is re-awakened from the Infinite Tsukuyomi. Tsunade retires from being the Fifth Hokage and Kakashi takes her place as the Sixth Hokage.

entries.name: (Sasuke's Revenge Arc)
entries.content: Sasuke's Revenge Arc really begins when he learns the truth behind the Uchiha Massacre from Obito and becomes so distraught and angry over it that he settles to destroy Konohakagure. He joins the Akatsuki and shows up at the 5 Kage Summit where the Kage meet to form The Allied Shinobi forces and discuss the Akatsuki collecting tailed-beasts. Sasuke fights the Raikage and almost beats him before Danzo - his main target escapes. Obito saves Sasuke from the Tsuchikage as he tries to use his Particle Jutsu to blast Sasuke from existence. Obito then presents his idea for the Infinite Tsukuyomi to the four Kage remaining, asking them to hand over Naruto (The 9-tails Jinchuriki) and they all decline. Obito then declares war - starting The Fourth Shinobi World War. Sasuke locates Danzo and absolutely annihilates him, which is fine because we all hate Danzo anyways. Orochimaru is awakened via Kabuto utilizing his cells to obtain Orochimaru's power and Orochimaru locates Sasuke, leading him to the resurrected Hokage of the past: Hashirama, Tobirama, Hiruzen and Minato. He finds out from them of the Uchiha's true past and that the Uchiha Massacre was basically inevitable. Sasuke gives up his revenge - settling on becoming Hokage and bearing the Cycle of Hatred alone by eliminating the remaining Kage in the world and anyone who wants to continue the Cycle of Hatred - ruling the world as the only Kage with an iron fist. This is when the Final Valley battle ensues after the 4th Shinobi World War between Naruto and Sasuke. Naruto - of course- wins!

entries.name: (Uchiha Clan Massacre Truth)
keys: the truth behind the Uchiha Clan Massacre
entries.content: After Itachi basically lets Sasuke kill him in a final showdown, Obito captures an extremely injured Sasuke and teaches him the Uchiha Clan Massacre Truth. This starts Sasuke's Revenge Arc. Itachi did NOT want Sasuke finding out about this in order to protect Konohagakure so he lied about - taking the secret with him to the grave.

entries.name: (Uchiha Clan Massacre)
entries.content: After being shunned and shut out by Konohagakure leaders, The Uchiha Clan grew despondent about their place in the village. Fugaku settles on a Coup D'Etat and in order to stop the revolt, The Third Hokage offers a compromise. Fugaku refuses and Danzo takes over from the root, ordering Itachi to act as a double agent, spying on the Uchiha Clan while Fugaku has Itachi spy on the higher ups of Konohagakure. Itachi is told by Danzo that if the revolt isn't canceled - their clan will have to be eliminated. Itachi does not want this to happen so he attempts to stop it. His attempts fail when Fugaku plans a date for the revolt. Danzo tells Itachi that either many people die trying to stop the revolt - or he himself must eliminate his clan to stop it. Itachi settles for the latter - wanting to avoid as much violence as possible due to being a pacifist at heart. He meets up with Shisui in a final attempt to plead with their clan to stop the revolt from happening, only to find out Danzo had stolen Shisui's right eye. Shisui gives Itachi his other eye - telling him to protect Konohagakure and the Uchiha name before he commits suicide over a cliff. Itachi thus awakens his Mangekyo Sharingan and becomes incredibly despondent. He returns to the Clan that night and after being accused of killing Shisui he kills everyone in the Uchiha Clan except for Sasuke (his younger brother) and Izanami (his lover). He couldn't kill Sasuke simply because he promised his father Fugaku that he would take care of him. He also couldn't bring himself to kill Sasuke. He lies to Sasuke about all of this - claiming selfish intent when Sasuke discovers his entire clan dead at Itachi's hands. Sasuke's Sharingan awaken that night. Itachi flees and settles with The Third Hokage to protect his brother Sasuke. The Hokage offers to keep Konoha’s barrier open to his chakra signature so he may enter/depart the village at free will without being detected. He threatens Danzo to never lay a hand on Sasuke or Izanami before departing and resigning himself to being an S-rank missing-nin - joining the Akatsuki to act as an undercover spy for Konohagakure.

entries.name: (Kabuto)
entries.content:
Gender: Male
Age: 23
Kabuto is Orochimaru's right hand man. He is skilled in chakra control and medical ninjutsu, able to pin-point the chakra network much like a Hyuga Clan member uses the gentle-fist technique. When Sasuke kills Orochimaru - Kabuto uses Orochimaru's cells to obtain his power. Kabuto wears circular lensed glasses and has silver/white hair tied into a pony-tail with center-parted bangs framing his face. He wears a high collared black t-shirt and beige pants. He is generally arrogant and cold.

entries.name: (Curse Mark)
entries.content: A curse mark is a Juinjutsu technique developed by Orochimaru. The shinobi curse with it gains access to increased levels of chakra and physical capabilities when the mark is active. When it is active - the body can grow limbs and appendages otherwise considered to be abnormal and the mark appears to cover the entire body in splotched designs of black. When Orochimaru bites and marks someone with this curse seal - it appears as three black tomoe on the victim's left sided back of their neck. This mark can be extremely painful and only some can survive it. The only known survivors currently are Anko and Sasuke.

entries.name: (Amaterasu)
entries.content:
When using Amaterasu, the Sharingan produce black flames at the focal point of the user's vision. Once created, the flames will not stop burning until their target is completely incinerated.

The flames cannot be extinguished with water, the passage of time or any other normal methods only the user can put the flames out. This jutsu was created by Itachi Uchiha.

entries.name: (Amegakure)
entries.content: Amegakure is a small but highly industrialized hidden village located in an unnamed country. As its name suggests, it rains almost constantly in Amegakure and the surrounding area. All the water seemingly ends in a large lake that surrounds the village. Pain became Ame's new leader, revered as a god by the populace because of his contributions during the civil war. None ever saw Pain directly, his decrees instead communicated to Ame's citizens by his "angel", Konan, who came to be revered almost as highly as Pain himself. Pain uses Amegakure as his base of operations for his work with Akatsuki alongside Konan, both of which only appear at the Akatsuki Hideout as holograms unless they need to be there for something special.

entries.name: (Akatsuki Hideout)
entries.content: The Akatsuki base is a location located near Mount Myōboku and the Hidden Sand Village. It consists of two rock platforms and an entrance to the Hideout. There is a wood structure outlining a boulder that covers a cave mouth to the hideout and it is sealed with a highly complex fuinjutsu lock, of which only Akatsuki members may pass through the boulder. Inside is a large open area that was once a cave with the Gedo Statue at the back. There are numerous tunnels/corridors with torches in sconces and small rooms for quarters that house the members.

entries.name: (Pain's Tower)
entries.content: This is the tallest tower in Amegakure and was also Pain's base of operations. It is where Pain and Konan mainly reside. It has four humanoid faces at each side and is connected to two smaller towers. The tongue of the face that Pain sat on, looking out over the city has Rinnegan-like eye patterns and is depicted with a pipe and has piercings, with its tongue stuck out. Somewhere inside is a chamber hidden behind a solid wall where the Six Paths of Pain's bodies are stored when not in use. At the base of the tower, members of Pain's forces deliver bodies. Its height allows Nagato to transmit chakra signals to the Paths regardless of their position in the city.

entries.name: (Akatsuki Main Mission)
entries.content:
Akatsuki mission explained: 
-Obtain enough money to support their organization.
-Provide mercenary services at well under the competitive rate, using the money gathered in the first step to offset costs. This will make countries increasingly dependent on Akatsuki's services, corner the entire market for shinobi missions, and eventually put all of the shinobi villages out of business because they can't compete with Akatsuki's prices. By capturing and strategically deploying the tailed beasts, Akatsuki could quickly start and then quell wars, thereby speeding up the process.
-Once all other major shinobi forces have dissolved, Akatsuki will be able to quickly conquer all the countries of the world.
Akatsuki Side Missions: 
-the hidden villages hire Akatsuki to fight in wars and perform assassinations that the villages themselves were unwilling to get involved in during times of peace.
